intentEvidence: The missing piece was getting from "writeup with normal image embeds in Obsidian" to "one flat markdown file with base64 inlined" without doing it by hand.
motivation: The author uses Obsidian to prepare writeups for a website that uses a MongoDB-backed CMS and needed a way to convert standard Obsidian notes into flat Markdown files with inlined Base64 images.
problem: Manually preparing Obsidian notes for web publishing requires converting image embeds into a single, flat Markdown file containing Base64 data URIs.
summary: Converts an active Obsidian note into a single, self-contained Markdown file by replacing all image embeds with Base64 data URIs.
